welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Tiká tómibongisa mpo na mobembo na yo.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Sololá na mwa mituna oyo etali bilembo na yo. Monganga na yo atalaka makambo nyonso liboso okutana na ye.

btnStart.translation: Kobanda kotuna bato liboso ya kokende kotala bango

hipaaFooter.translation: Moto oyo azali kotosa HIPAA · NeuronbytesAI

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Yango eyokanisi vizite na yo na makomi na yo.

labelComplaint.translation: Nini esali ete ozala na esengo lelo oyo?

placeholderComplaint.translation: Lobelá elembo na yo ya libosoliboso.

interviewAsking.translation: Nazali kotuna yo mpo na bilembo na yo

interviewLoadError.translation: Tozalaki te na likoki ya kokoma lisolo na yo.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Matɔndi Nakotuna yo mwa mituna mpo na koyeba nini ememaki yo kuna.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Tyá eyano, to tyá likanisi oyo ezali awa na likoló

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Liboso ya kotinda yango, tyá elembo moko mpo obongisa yango.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Emonani malamu tindá ye epai ya monganga

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Soki omoni ete bilembo na yo ezali makasi to ezali kobakisama, kozela te bengá lisalisi ya monganga.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Tosɛngi yo oluka lisalisi kati na ngonga 1 2

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Bilembo na yo bizali komonisa likambo moko oyo esengeli komonana mosika te.

urgencyStep1Title.translation: Bakotindela yo mokanda na yo sikoyo

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ekipi ya monganga ekozwa lisoló na yo nokinoki.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Soki ekómi mabe koleka, salá nokinoki

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Bokono makasi to ya mbalakaka bengá nokinoki lisalisi ya monganga.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Ezali mpo na koyeba soki maladi yango ezali makasi to te, kasi mpo na kozwa ekateli ya nsuka, minganga nde bazwaka yango.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Bato bamoná yo na lopitalo oyo liboso.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Bamonaka makambo nyonso oyo okutanaki na yango, yango wana ekipi na yo ya mosala ya monganga emonaka yango mbala moko.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findScanning.translation: Nazali kosala scan na lopitalo ya Triavi oyo ezali pene na bino...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Mokanda na yo ezali na lopitalo, tokoyebisa yo ntango monganga akofungola yango.

timelineReviewing.translation: Monganga azali kotalela mokanda na yo

timelineOpened.translation: Monganga moko afungolaki mokanda na yo

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Soki ekómi mabe koleka, salá yango sikoyo

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Soki bilembo na yo ezali makasi to ezali kobeba na mbalakaka bengá lisalisi ya mpunda sikoyo to kende na biro ya mpunda oyo ezali pene.

escalateCallEmergency.translation: Bengá bato oyo basalisaka na lombangu

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Tokomonisa ete likambo na yo ezali na ntina mingi mpo bato oyo bazali kosalisa biso báyeba yango.

notifyTitle.translation: Triavi · Mokanda na yo ezali polele

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Monganga moko azali kotalela mokanda na yo. Tokopesa yo bansango wana ezali kokende liboso.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Yanolá na mwa mituna oyo etali ndenge ozali kobanda na mobembo na yo.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Ndenge nini maladi na yo ekokani na oyo ya liboso?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ezali na likambo mosusu oyo okolinga koyebisa biso?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Tozali na esengo ete ozali komiyoka malamu

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Bamemi biyano na yo epai ya minganga oyo batyelaka yo likebi, mpe soki esengeli, monganga akotalela yango mpe akosalisa yo.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Kozela te sololá na ekipi na yo ya kosalisa bato to kende na lopitalo oyo ezali pene na yo.

checkinResultEscalateCall.translation: Bengá bato oyo basalisaka na lombangu

checkinExpired.translation: Lokasa oyo ya kokomisa nkombo esili

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Koyeba makambo yango ezali lisusu te. Kokɔta mpo na komona makambo oyo ozali kosala sikoyo.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Okoki kofungola compte ya ofele mpo na kolanda vizite oyo mpe kobosana code na mbala oyo ekoya.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Tokotinda kode ya mbala moko mpe tokobosana yango te.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi esimbaki mbongo na yango · esimbaki na HIPAA

authUseInstead.translation: Salelá nde {channel} na esika na yango

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Komá telefone to email na yo mpe tokotindela yo kode ya kokɔta.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Motángo na yo ezali na boyokani na mikanda ya lopitalo na yo

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Komá nimero ya telefone oyo ebongi (714 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Nakokaki te kotindela yo code yango.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Komeka lisusu mpo na koyeba soki ozali na likoki ya kokɔta na Internet.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Mpo na bolamu na yo mpe mpo na kobatela ba données ya monganga, obimaki na mosala nsima ya eleko moko ya kozanga mosala.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Bandá kokomisa nkombo mpo na kobanda mobembo ya sika.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Ba app oyo ezali kobenga bato mpo na kosunga bango · nimero na yo ya telefone ekopesama te.

dashRecentCalls.translation: Bato oyo basɛngi lisalisi na mikolo euti koleka

dashSimulateCall.translation: Kokanisa na telefone oyo ezali koya na lisalisi ya monganga · demo

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Poná moto oyo azali kobenga yo mpe ndenge oyo azali koyoka.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Nazali na elikya mpe nalɛmbi te

toneProfessional.translation: Ezali polele mpe ezali na makambo mingi ya kosala

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Ezali polele, ezali polele, ezali na maloba ya kozokisa te

toneUpbeat.translation: Bazali na esengo mpe na esengo

toneUpbeatDesc.translation: Nguya ya boboto mpe ya kolendisa

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Bonjour Jordan, ntango ekoki mpo na dose na yo ya mpokwa...

medReminderCalls.translation: Kobengisa mpo na kokundwela yo nkisi

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Zwá elembo na monganga nyonso oyo otye na molɔngɔ

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: "Ozali komiyoka ndenge nini?" nsima ya kobima na mosala

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Bazalaki kobenga te na 9h30 7h30 · kozonga na notification

yourCareAgent.translation: Mwasi na yo oyo asalisaka yo

careCallsRow.translation: Makanisi ya mongongo mpe ya kobenga

dataPrivacy.translation: Masolo na yo & boninga na yo

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Lokasa na yo ya kobatela bato ekotikala na makasi kozonga mpo na kokamba ba appels mpe ba rappel.

welcomeMyDashboard.translation: Tablo na ngai ya kotambwisa makambo

callRingIncoming.translation: Mobembo ya lisalisi oyo ezali koya

callRingVerified.translation: Esimbami · na nzela ya lisungi na yo {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Kobenga na mongongo ya kobombama · WebRTC · nimero na yo ekopesama te

callActiveLive.translation: MAKAMBO YA MOTUYA NA LILOBA YA NZAMBE

callActiveEndNo.translation: Kobá kosala yango na ngonga oyo ebongi

callSummarySnoozed.translation: LIKAMBO YA KOBONGOLA LIKAMBO YA MWAKA 1

visitsSubtitle.translation: Lisolo na yo ya kala na {hospital}

visitDetailCalls.translation: MAKAMBO YA MOTUYA NA LISANGÁ oyo

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Oyo ezali maloba ya mokuse oyo opesi yo kasi ezali te nkisi. Soki bilembo na yo ezongi to ekómi lisusu mabe, luká lisalisi ya nokinoki.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Ekoki kozala ete bakolongolaka vizite yango, to link yango ezali lisusu na ntina te.

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: Ekipi na yo ya kosalisa bato oyo bazali na maladi ebimi

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Yebisá monganga makambo nyonso oyo ezali koleka.

labelEmergencyContact.translation: Kosangana na bato oyo bazali na mposa ya lisalisi

labelEmergencyName.translation: Kombo ya bato oyo basololaka na bango

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Nkombo ya moto oyo okutanaki na ye na likama

placeholderEmergencyPhone.translation: Motángo ya telefone ya moto oyo asololaki na ye

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Ebongolaka monɔkɔ ya ekrime nyonso mbala moko.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Nakokaki te kokoma - pona mpe kokoma yango na lobɔkɔ

privacyTitle.translation: Masolo na yo & boninga na yo

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Makambo oyo biso tozali kobatela, mpe makambo oyo yo ozali koyangela.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Liboso ete eloko moko ebima na lopitalo, bakolongola nkombo na yo, bankombo na yo, mpe biyano na yo oyo ezali na makomi ya polele.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Okoki kobongola yango ntango nyonso oyo olingi.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Esengeli kolongola yango mpo na libela, mpe lopitalo ebatelaka makambo nyonso oyo elekaki mpo na kosalisa yo, ndenge mibeko esɛngi yango.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Sɛngá mokanda ya kozongela yo, nkisi oyo opesaki mpe makambo oyo okutanaki na yango na mosala ya monganga.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Yango ekolongolama mpo na libela, mpe lopitalo na yo ekobatela makambo oyo okutanaki na yango na mosala ya monganga, ndenge mibeko esɛngi yango.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ekipi na yo ekoyebisa yo yango na e-mail na boumeli ya ngonga 72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Poná lolenge moko mpe sɛngá ete bátinda yo yango. Tokobongisa yango mpe tokotindela yo nzela ya malamu mpo na kotindela yo mesaje na yo ya e-mail.

downloadRequestSubmitted.translation: Lisɛngi ya kobimisa biloko ya sika

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Tokotindela yo mesaje na adrɛsi na yo na boumeli ya ngonga 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ezali na bafiliale te oyo ezali kopesama awa - mikanda na yo etindamaka na nkomá na yo ya ordinatɛrɛ.

ariaCheckinProgress.translation: Kokende liboso na mosala ya kokomisa mikanda

ariaInviteLink.translation: Kobengisa na nzela to na code

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Mobembo esilaki? ba enregistrés lokola contact te

statusSavedToAccount.translation: Babombaki yango na compte na yo

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Tyá elembo ya lokasa ya libyangi oyo lopitalo na yo etindeli yo, to talá kode QR na yango.

inviteInputLabel.translation: Kobengisa na nzela to na code

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Yango emonani te lokola nzela to code ya libyangi ya Triavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code
inviteScanSubtitle.translation: Tinda aparɛyi na yo na code

inviteCameraDenied.translation: Bazali koboya kokɔta na aparɛyi yango

inviteEnterManually.translation: Komá na lobɔkɔ link ya libyangi

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Kode ya lopitalo oyo ebongi ezali komema yo mbala moko na makambo na yo.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Kode ya lopitalo oyo ebongi ezali komema yo mbala moko na makambo na yo.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Pesá bakamera ndingisa na ba paramètres ya navigateur na yo, to tyá lien ya libyangi na mabɔkɔ.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Moto moko te amonaki yango, na esika ya yango, tiká lokasa ya libyangi oyo lopitalo na yo etindaki.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kamera ezali te sikoyo, tyá lokasa ya libyangi na lobɔkɔ.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Kolakisa maniskri ya interview oyo ebombami

otpGroupAriaLabel.translation: Kode ya mbala moko, oyo ezali na mitángo motoba
